messages:
maya-eng: quick heads-up — planning to publish py/ts SDKs during the Thursday change window (2026-03-25 22:00 UTC). canary -> stable cut.
rafael-devex: ack. what are the version pins + deprecation notices we need in release notes?
june-release: proposed: py 0.12.0 (drops legacy sync client), ts 2.8.0 (soft-deprecate sync). include migration snippet and highlight breaking import paths.
oliver-sre: :eyes: any infra churn? will Dedicated customers see a rollout? we should avoid autoscale during window.
maya-eng: no infra changes. just packaging. we will run canary publish first, then 1h of telemetry, then promote.
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: npm canary publish at 2026-03-25T22:05:00Z by @june-release. CI checks required: dist-sign, smoke-tests, shasum.
ci-bot: CI: all checks green for canary -> smoke OK. artifact signatures attached.
rafael-devex: checklist for publish:
1) update CHANGELOG.md
2) pin legacy package names to 0.11.x for npm and 0.11.* for pip via deprecate notices
3) run `python -m pip index versions redwood-sdk` and `npm dist-tag ls @redwood/sdk`
4) notify customers via #announcements
maya-eng: for pinning, we'll publish a deprecation package: `pip install redwood-sdk-legacy==0.11.9` and add a postinstall message in TS.
june-release: doing canary tag as `0.12.0-canary.20260325` and npm dist-tag `canary`. if smoke passes, promote with `npm dist-tag add @redwood/sdk@0.12.0 latest` and `twine upload` for python.
oliver-sre: rollback plan:
- unpublish canary if bad: `npm unpublish @redwood/sdk@0.12.0-canary.* --force` (only canary)
- revert dist-tag promotion if stable: `npm dist-tag add @redwood/sdk@0.11.9 latest`
- for python: yank 0.12.0 from PyPI and re-promote 0.11.9
maya-eng: approval from @oliver-sre and @rafael-devex needed before promote. also add feature flag gating in SDK that enables new behavior only when `REDWOOD_NEW_CLIENT=1` to reduce risk.
june-release: will run docs publish job after promote. canary release ETA 22:05, promote ETA 23:10 if metrics look good.
rafael-devex: I'll prepare deprecation blurb for website and migration guide. will add a one-liner in release notes: "Sync client deprecated — async first. See migration guide."
maya-eng: last question — do we pin package.json peer deps? we should keep broad semver but add engines >= node14.
june-release: agreed, pin peerDeps min versions, don't force exact.
oliver-sre: :thumbsup: i'll be on standby between 22:00-00:00 UTC.
deploy-bot: Reminder scheduled: canary publish in 10 minutes.
maya-eng: thanks all. tagging for approval: @oliver-sre, @rafael-devex, @june-release :shipit:
oliver-sre: approved. :white_check_mark:
rafael-devex: approved. :white_check_mark:
june-release: proceeding shortly. will post final release notes link here.
ci-bot: Post-publish smoke results will be posted to this thread automatically.
